title: 模型路由共识形成，Transformer 联合作者谈泛化边界
summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie 和 Google 前 Gemini 产品负责人 Madhu Guru 在同一天发出几乎一致的判断——模型路由（Model Routing）将成为应用 AI 层的核心差异化武器。 同日，Transformer 论文联合作者 Lucas Kaiser 在 Unsupervised Lear

items.title: Aaron Levie
items.summary:
Token costs are becoming one of the hottest topics for any enterprise I talk with right now. It’s very bullish for AI in general because it means these systems are being used at a scale that wasn’t contemplated before. 

It also gives way to another form of differentiation that
items.translation: Box CEO Aaron Levie：Token 成本已成企业 AI 部署最热话题——这说明系统正在以空前的规模被使用，对 AI 是极度利好。模型路由将成为应用 AI 层的下一个差异化武器：最好的 evals + 工作负载路由能力 + 与客户财务目标对齐的商业模式，将是最大护城河。

items.title: Madhu Guru
items.summary:
Routing to models is genuinely hard. It means mapping each task to the right model - which requires benchmarking models against your product's specific tasks and dialing in the quality/cost trade-off. 

And there is an opportunity in that difficulty.

Here is the progression I
items.translation: 前 Google Gemini 产品负责人 Madhu Guru 梳理企业模型路由三阶段：Phase 1 (2024) 盲选 GPT → Phase 2 (2025初) 过度优化 → Phase 3 (现在) 精细化路由，将最难推理分配给 Claude、最简单分配给 Gemini Flash-Lite。AI-native 创业公司率先做到，企业跟进慢 6-9 个月。

items.title: Garry Tan
items.summary:
We never said we don't upload any user data to the cloud. We said the code (file contents) specifically doesn't. 

Paxel is here to help you, and over time as local models get better, we'll be able to do even more locally. Can't wait, tbh.
items.translation: Garry Tan 回应 Paxel 数据隐私争议：代码内容不上传云端，但其他数据会。随着本地模型进步，未来更多处理会在本地完成。

items.title: Dan Shipper 📧
items.summary:
LLMs are not conscious. 

LLMs are not not conscious. 

Both true.
items.translation: Every CEO Dan Shipper 玩了一个精巧的哲学悖论：「LLM 没有意识」和「LLM 并非没有意识」同时为真——与柏拉图《普罗泰戈拉篇》中关于技艺（techne）局限性、敬畏（aidos）和正义（dike）必要性的讨论相呼应。

items.title: Dan Shipper 📧
items.summary:
my absolute favorite of Plato's Dialogues is a deep discussion of the limits of techne and the necessity of aidos and dike

Protagoras here, in the way he talks about where knowledge comes from and whether virtue can be taught,  pre-sages LLMs:
https://t.co/8pDOaMnIIa
items.translation: Dan Shipper 推荐柏拉图《普罗泰戈拉篇》：关于知识来源和德性是否可教的讨论，预言了 LLM 时代的核心命题——仅有技艺（techne）是不够的，还需要敬畏（aidos）和正义（dike）。

items.title: Dan Shipper 📧
items.summary:
to add two more that increase in value:

Aidōs—reverence and responsiveness to others 
Dikē—the capacity to perceive what is right
items.translation: Dan Shipper 进一步阐述：AI 时代最有价值的两项能力——Aidōs（对他人的敬畏与回应）和 Dikē（感知正确的能力）。这些品质在 AI 可复制一切的年代只会更加珍贵。

items.title: Zara Zhang
items.summary:
Really enjoyed this talk!
The value of static content is going down, the value of live interaction is going up
People want to connect with the human being behind a piece of work, whether it's content or software
Raw & opinionated > polished & generic
items.translation: Builder Zara Zhang 分享观察：静态内容价值在下降，实时互动价值在上升。人们想连接的是作品背后的人。Raw and opinionated > polished and generic。
